observed_gap: Taowind Code bridge still surfaced only the NorthStar controller native execution mode even though the latest DWAC/TaoX exposes a four-mode user-level router.
TaskStore encoded WHOLE_ARTIFACT and DEEP_DEVELOPMENT as a fixed sequential phase list, which contradicted autonomous mode routing.
changes: bridge/dwac_bridge.py consumes FourDevelopmentModeRouter when available, preserves native_mode separately, and exposes routing source, signal, reason and scores.
core/tasks.mjs replaces the fixed WHOLE_ARTIFACT -> DEEP_DEVELOPMENT task sequence with one routed develop phase whose mode follows the run.
tests/four-mode-routing.test.mjs verifies four-mode routing, native-mode provenance and honest fallback.
truth_boundaries: The focused bridge tests use a synthetic DWAC root implementing the upstream contract; this evidence does not claim a full real latest TaoX runtime bind inside the isolated validation sandbox.

If four_mode_router is unavailable in a bound DWAC package, Taowind Code fails back to the native NorthStar mode and exposes NORTH_STAR_NATIVE_FALLBACK instead of pretending four-mode routing occurred.
No GitHub Actions were triggered or rerun for this verification.
